mechanism: Lopinavir inhibits CYP3A4 which may increase ceftazidime levels; ceftazidime is primarily renally eliminated with minor hepatic metabolism, creating potential for altered clearance in patients with renal impairment.
action: Monitor renal function closely and adjust ceftazidime dosing based on creatinine clearance; no routine dose adjustment needed for lopinavir, but increased vigilance for beta-lactam toxicity is warranted.
